title: Strawberries and Knee Osteoarthritis (OA)
brief_summary: The proposed study aims to examine the hypothesis that strawberry supplementation will lower serum biomarkers of inflammation and improve knee function in patients with symptomatic osteoarthritis (OA).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of knee osteoarthritis
* Must have waist circumference \>35 inches for women and \>40 inches for men

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cancer
* Heart disease
* Smoking
* Berry allergy
